What kind of issue is this?

- [ ] **Question**.
      This issue tracker is not the place for questions. If you want to ask how to do something,
      or to understand why something isn't working the way you expect it to,
      please use the [pioarduino Discussions](https://github.com/pioarduino/platformio-core/discussions)
      or the [Discord community](https://discord.gg/Nutz9crnZr).

- [ ] **pioarduino IDE**.
      All issues related to the pioarduino IDE for VS Code should be reported to the
      [pioarduino-vscode-ide](https://github.com/pioarduino/pioarduino-vscode-ide/issues) repository.

- [ ] **Development Platform or Board**.
      All issues (building, uploading, adding new boards, etc.) related to the espressif32 platform
      should be reported to [pioarduino/platform-espressif32](https://github.com/pioarduino/platform-espressif32/issues).

- [ ] **Feature Request**.
      Start by telling us what problem you're trying to solve. Often a solution
      already exists! Don't send pull requests to implement new features without first getting our
      support. Sometimes we leave features out on purpose to keep the project small.

- [ ] **pioarduino Core Bug**.
      If you've found a bug in pioarduino Core, please provide the information below.
